name: unifact
description: Ground Claude in governed organizational facts
long_description: UniFact gives Claude a governed source of organizational truth for policies, decisions, ownership, customer commitments, product identity, infrastructure, compliance, and operating procedures. It supports read-first Fact Checks and controlled fact proposals while reserving publication and destructive lifecycle actions for explicit user approval.

database_path.title: UniFact database
database_path.description: Choose an existing UniFact SQLite store, or keep the default path for a separate Claude store.
